Summary: Jesus' resurrection is the firstfruits of the new creation, God's public declaration that death does not have the last word. Believers share that life now, raised with Christ and empowered by the Spirit to walk in newness of life. One day our bodies too will be raised, imperishable, to share His glory forever.
KeyPassages: John 11:25-26; Romans 6:4-5; 1 Corinthians 15:20-22; Philippians 3:10-11; Colossians 3:1; 1 Peter 1:3
